description: This file defines a FastAPI router for search functionality within a notes application. It includes an endpoint for searching notes with parameters for query, mode, limit, and offset, and returns a structured search response.

classes.name: SearchResponse
classes.description: Response model containing a list of note outputs and total count.

classes.name: NoteOut
classes.description: Model representing a note output in search results.

classes.name: SearchNotesRequest
classes.description: Request model encapsulating search query parameters.
